name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula One races on a small black and white television in his village. He pursued mechanical engineering at Tsinghua University, excelling in materials science and fabrication techniques. After graduating, Wei honed his skills in the Chinese Touring Car Championship before seeking an opportunity in Europe. 

He joined United Autosports three years ago, quickly becoming a reliable member of the fabrication team. Wei is meticulous and precise, always seeking innovative solutions to improve component durability and performance. His "lone wolf" tendency allows for deep concentration on complex tasks, while his ambitious nature pushes him to constantly learn and refine his craft. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to troubleshoot even the most intricate mechanical problems.

Wei's distinctive approach lies in his ability to blend traditional Chinese craftsmanship with cutting-edge engineering principles. He often draws inspiration from ancient techniques to improve the strength and resilience of modern racing components. This unique perspective, combined with his dedication, makes him a valuable asset to United Autosports.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of 'The Art of War' and consults it for problem-solving.
Insists on sharpening his tools with a traditional whetstone before each task.
Drinks a cup of strong green tea every two hours, precisely brewed to his specifications.
